## React frontend

- Inspect and reuse existing components, hooks, API clients, types, and styling patterns.
- Keep API calls in the existing client/service layer.
- Do not duplicate backend business rules in React.
- Handle loading, empty, error, and success states.
- Avoid unnecessary global state.
- Do not add a state-management library unless explicitly requested.
- Reuse existing table, form, modal, notification, and chart components.
- Keep TypeScript types aligned with API DTOs.
- Do not use `any` unless unavoidable and justified.
